topic: Marschner cuticle-tilted dual hair glints vs Kajiya-Kay single lobe rig
topic_zh: Marschner 毛鳞片双高光天使环对比 Kajiya-Kay 单波瓣塑料假发
scope: Deterministic Stephen Marschner et al. (SIGGRAPH 2003) cuticle-tilted dual longitudinal hair scattering (root-shifted white R glint at -2*alpha_c = -6.0 deg with I=1.0000 and tip-shifted colored TRT glint at +8.0 deg with I=0.8000) versus naive unshifted Kajiya-Kay single lobe (0.0 deg peak) and 64-ray dielectric cylinder quadrature across 17 longitudinal half-angles (theta_h in [-16.0 deg, +16.0 deg]).

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Closed-form cuticle-shifted R+TRT dual-Gaussian evaluation versus 64-ray dielectric cylinder internal refraction quadrature.

robustness.name: Sampled 17 longitudinal half-angle stations resolve distinct root-shifted R and tip-shifted TRT angel rings

good_fit: Digital human hair, animal fur, and keratin fibers in UE5 Groom, Blender Principled Hair BSDF, and RenderMan
Separating the sharp white surface glint (R at -6.0°) from the warm melanin-colored internal glint (TRT at +8.0°)
Eliminating the single unshifted 0.0° plastic wig band and -99.25% TRT starvation of Kajiya-Kay shaders
Evaluating dual longitudinal Gaussians in 6 scalar operations without per-ray cylinder tracing
not_for: Synthetic cylindrical nylon wires lacking tilted imbricated cuticle scales (alpha_c == 0°)
Flat isotropic plastic or matte masonry
Upright velvet cloth pile (use Estevez-Kulla Charlie Sheen Round 103)
Unlit billboard hair cards without tangent vectors
